common.title: Invitation
common.signout: Sign out to use another account

landing.title: Open your invitation
landing.description: Continue with the invitation from your email, or paste the complete code from that email below.
landing.no_script: JavaScript is off. Open the clean /invitations address and paste the separate code from the email. A fragment in the address cannot be removed automatically without JavaScript.
landing.invalid: This invitation code is not valid. Paste the complete code from the original email.

confirm.signin: Sign in to the account that received the invitation. You can create an account on the sign-in page.
confirm.signin_action: Sign in or create an account
confirm.bootstrap: Create your LearnStack identity to continue. This does not yet join the institution.
confirm.inspect: Check this invitation using your account’s current verified email.
confirm.forbidden: This account cannot currently confirm the invitation. Verify your email, or sign out and use the account that received the invitation.
confirm.verification_hint: After completing email verification, return here and check the invitation again. Verification alone does not accept it.
confirm.ready: Confirm the verified account and the offered membership before accepting.
confirm.accepted: Your invitation is accepted and the membership is created.
confirm.already_member: You already have an active membership in this scope. The invitation is accepted; your existing roles and profile are unchanged.
confirm.session_ready: Your session is ready. Continue to the institution site.
confirm.session_unavailable: Your membership is confirmed, but a session could not be opened. Check the result to try session admission again.

failure.unknown: The acceptance outcome could not be confirmed. Check the result before doing anything else; this will not submit a new acceptance.
failure.unavailable: The invitation service is temporarily unavailable. Try again when you are ready.
failure.expired: This invitation continuation is no longer available. Reopen the original email to start again. An expired or replaced invitation needs a new email from the institution.
failure.account_change: The signed-in account changed. Your existing session has been preserved. Sign out explicitly before continuing with another account.
